scope: original Prime31 fixed supports; sufficient one-slot determinant witness and exterior-span implication only
statement: For the fixed original Prime31 supports containing canonical base x=0,1,2,3, the corrected local Rust analytic certificate reports nonzero exact 8x8 signed-row determinants for all eight slots at both frozen residuals, 32 distinct forbidden target x-coordinates, and an at-most-64-point exceptional set for this sufficient witness. Together with the exterior multilinearity argument this implies left, right, and complementary-pairing rank 70 for N4/P4/N8/P8 and for every finite target outside that exceptional set. Exceptional targets, nonlinear extraction, SAT/F4/XL and ECDLP cost remain unproved.
